description: State Representative Fred Atchley (R-Sevierville) is recognizing eight Sevier County volunteer fire departments and rescue agencies that received more than $166,000 in state grant funding over the past year through the Tennessee Department of Commerce and Insurance and the State Fire Marshal's Office.The grants support equipment, training, and operational needs for the first responders who serve communities across District 12.
